correctness.rationale: Each binary response path constrains the candidate permutations to the linear extensions of the comparisons' transitive closure. A depth-d tree has 2^d mutually disjoint, nonempty leaf classes, and each feasible root split must leave two depth-(d−1) classes. I independently decoded every stored certificate by response-path bits, using direct position comparisons in the lexicographic permutations (not the supplied split code). The numbers of checked leaves were 1,2,4,16,64,512,2048 and all were distinct within each tree. To exclude depth 12, it suffices by relabeling to test depth 11 for one oriented first response. I exhaustively split tuples of ranks in the 2520-permutation half-class, allowing every unordered comparison and pruning only if either child lacked 2^(d−1) permutations; depth 11 failed (766 memoized states). Thus the profile is (0,1,2,4,6,9,11), strictly below the factorial leaf bound first at seven labels. For VC shattering every graph orientation must extend to a total order, equivalent to having no undirected cycle; a forest on n vertices has at most n−1 edges and spanning trees attain this. Replay: python3 /workspace/review-replay.py 5 with the frozen comparison_certificates.json path. Only the VC identity is all-n.

Alon et al. allow whole-ranking proposals and possibly false counterexamples. Resultary 6c4de5b628dc covers the same exact profile and adds a block-concatenation lower bound.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Generalizing a model is not coverage of an exact invariant unless its bound or theorem specializes to the claimed numbers. No inspected earlier bound does so at seven. The later-listed 6c4de5b628dc does cover the exact numbers.

evidence: The balancing argument in the 1993 paper preserves a constant fraction of linear extensions in either child, not necessarily enough for another complete near-capacity subtree. Exact majority halving gives the factorial capacity bound (12 for n=7), not the sharper 11. Sorting from Counterexamples measures queries needed to identify the order after whole-order guesses.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A sorting identification lower bound concerns a tree separating all permutations, not a complete shattered subtree in which every path retains a consistent permutation. Neither the old balancing guarantee, a general mistake bound, nor sorting complexity yields the exact deficit by specialization.

evidence: Goldman et al. use adversarial instance selection on ordered comparisons and monitor the linear extensions left in the version space. Feng et al. §5.2 explicitly specialize to one pair at r=1. Filmus et al. give the general deterministic mistake-bound interpretation of Littlestone dimension.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Index permutations by their rank functions; comparing ranks is the same Boolean concept class. Ordered pairs simply add reverse queries with negated answers, leaving the dimension unchanged. The equivalence makes the older mistake-bound sources directly relevant, but the inspected bounds are not the exact finite profile.
